description: This file defines the PcbNode class and its related subclasses, which are used to parse, represent, and serialize nodes within a printed circuit board (PCB) netlist or schematic. It includes methods for reading and writing PCB node structures from files, parsing content into node objects, and providing access to child nodes and node attributes.

classes.name: PcbNode
classes.description: The core class representing a generic PCB node, with capabilities for parsing from string, managing child nodes, and serialization.

classes.name: SegmentNode
classes.description: A subclass of PcbNode representing a segment in the PCB layout (inferred from context).

classes.name: PadNode
classes.description: A subclass handling pad-specific nodes, with specialized parsing.

classes.name: NetNode
classes.description: Represents a net in the PCB, typically a collection of electrical connections.

classes.name: AddNetNode
classes.description: Represents an add_net node, likely for defining additional connections.

classes.name: GrLineNode
classes.description: Represents a graphical line element in the PCB layout.

classes.name: LayerNode
classes.description: Represents a layer in the PCB design.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a module or component placement.

classes.name: ZoneNode
classes.description: Represents a zone, probably for copper pours or areas.

classes.name: ViaNode
classes.description: Represents a via in the PCB layout.

classes.name: PointNode
classes.description: Represents coordinate points such as start, end, or at positions.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads PCB node structure from a file and parses it into a PcbNode object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Recursively parses a string content into a hierarchy of PCB nodes.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the node and its children into a string.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the node structure to a specified file.

methods.name: setDouble
methods.description: Sets a child value at a specified index to a double value.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a child value as a double.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if a child with a specific key exists.

methods.name: findIfExists
methods.description: Finds and returns a child node with the specified key if it exists.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a child node with the specified key, expects exactly one match.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes matching a given key.
